# NEW 2026-11-22 v18.0 Module 18.0-A: Scripted Effects & O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook (oe_io3_kernel_yearly) (oe_io3_effects.txt) (oe_io3_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v180_resolutions_parliaments.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# O(1) zero-slot yearly dispatcher exported for global kernel integration.
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_io3_ran_y ?= current_year.
oe_io3_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_io3_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_io3_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_io3_yearly_runs } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_io3_yearly_runs value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_io3_yearly_runs add = 1 }
		}
		oe_io3_dispatch_yearly_events = yes
	}
}

# Telemetry counter bumped when any oe_io3_ native IO resolution passes.
oe_io3_bump_passed_counter = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_io3_res_passed_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_passed_count value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_io3_res_passed_count add = 1 }
	}
}

# Helper called when any oe_io3_ civilization parliament issue passes.
oe_io3_on_civ_parl_passed = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_parl_passed_count } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_io3_parl_passed_count value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { name = oe_io3_parl_passed_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_7 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_7 years = 18 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.7
	}
}

# Helper called when any oe_io3_ estate parliament agenda is accepted.
oe_io3_on_agenda_accepted = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_agenda_count } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_io3_agenda_count value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { name = oe_io3_agenda_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_8 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_8 years = 18 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.8
	}
}

# Yearly O(1) milestone event dispatcher for human players & great powers participating
# in major IOs and native civilization parliaments (oe_io3.1 .. oe_io3.8, 0 orphans).
oe_io3_dispatch_yearly_events = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			oe_io3_is_eligible_realm = yes
			oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
			OR = {
				is_ai = no
				is_great_power = yes
			}
			OR = {
				oe_io3_is_in_major_io = yes
				oe_io3_is_any_civ_parl = yes
			}
		}
		# 1. Middle Kingdom Celestial Assembly milestone (oe_io3.1)
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1345
				exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
				is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_1 }
				OR = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
					is_ai = no
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_1 years = 25 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.1
		}
		# 2. Autocephalous Patriarchate Ecumenical Synod milestone (oe_io3.2, unique = no!)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1348
				is_member_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = autocephalous_patriarchate }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_2 }
				OR = {
					is_ai = no
					is_great_power = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_2 years = 25 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.2
		}
		# 3. HRE Imperial Diet milestone (oe_io3.3)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1350
				exists = international_organization:hre
				is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_3 }
				OR = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
					is_elector = yes
					is_ai = no
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_3 years = 25 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.3
		}
		# 4. Catholic Church Sacred Consistory milestone (oe_io3.4)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1352
				papacy_active = yes
				exists = international_organization:catholic_church
				is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:catholic_church
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_4 }
				OR = {
					num_cardinals > 0
					is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:catholic_church
					is_ai = no
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_4 years = 25 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.4
		}
		# 5. Tatar Yoke / Japanese Shogunate Council milestone (oe_io3.5)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1350
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_5 }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						exists = international_organization:tatar_yoke
						is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke
					}
					AND = {
						exists = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
						is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_5 years = 25 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.5
		}
		# 6. Eurasian Concert Grand Congress milestone (oe_io3.6)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
				is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_6 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_6 years = 25 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.6
		}
		# 7. Active Civilizational Native Parliament session milestone (oe_io3.7)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1344
				has_parliament = yes
				is_active_parliament = yes
				oe_io3_is_any_civ_parl = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_7 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_7 years = 22 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.7
		}
		# 8. Historic Estates Constitutional Compact milestone (oe_io3.8)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1355
				has_parliament = yes
				oe_io3_is_any_civ_parl = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_io3_cd_ev_8 }
				OR = {
					is_ai = no
					num_locations >= 20
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_io3_cd_ev_8 years = 25 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_io3.8
		}
	}
}
